newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy up, corn and wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy up, corn and wheat steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis offers rose two cents a bushel on Friday in most positions, bolstered by scant farm sales and strong processor demand, dealers said.
"Processors were definitely buying," one U.S. exporter said.
CIF bids for soybeans for May delivery at U.S. Gulf of Mexico locations also jumped several cents a bushel early Friday.
An Illinois shipper said strong demand from soybean processors, evidenced by the slightly larger than expected weekly soybean crush, forced exporters to raise prices.
One dealer said soybean processors have been active all week. "They are getting nervous and moving most of the grain their way," he said.
Corn and wheat values were steady.
